every product answers instance/v1's words, so a client reading details is told the project is unreadable when the cloud said it may not write a volume
the 404 products answer 403 too, so vpc and ipam stop saying which identifier was not found
an empty project is refused too, so a client configured from `feint env` meets the refusal on its first create
a delete no longer counts what the project holds, so it answers 204 over resources that outlive it
the delete answers instance/v1's 400 for the same body, so a client branching on the status takes its malformed-request path
